🧱 Computer vision

Convolutional neural network (CNN)

In simple words

A neural network for pictures whose layers use convolutions to find patterns, from edges up to whole objects.

A neural network built for images. Its first layers use convolutions to find simple patterns such as edges; the next layers combine them into shapes, then parts, then whole objects. During training, the network learns its filters by itself.

Example. Apps that tell you which plant or animal is in your photo often use networks like this.

Lessons that teach it

  • Lesson 7: How Computers See

Related words

  • ConvolutionSliding a small grid of numbers (a filter) across a picture to find patterns such as edges.
  • PixelOne tiny square of a digital picture, stored as numbers that say how bright it is or what colour it has.
  • Computer visionThe area of AI that helps computers find and recognise things in photos and videos.
  • Neural networkAn AI model made of many simple connected units (neurons), arranged in layers, that learn patterns together.
  • Adversarial exampleAn input changed very slightly, often invisibly to people, so that an AI model makes a mistake.
